panels.title: Pis
panels.description: One row per store's Pi. Red cells: last seen over 5 min (offline), disk under 500 MB, temp over 80 C, SD errors above 0 (swap the card), failed updates.

targets.expr: time() - max by (tenant) (max_over_time(timestamp(max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?|agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}))[1d:1m]))

panels.title: Pis per agent version
panels.description: How many Pis run each agent version. A rollout shows as one band handing over to the next; a band that lingers is a Pi that did not update.

panels.title: Tablets per Quibase version
panels.description: Connected tablets per Quibase version. After a release the old band should drain within minutes as tablets self-update.

panels.title: Updates and restarts
panels.description: Agent update runs by result, and agent/Pi restarts (uptime resets). Restarts without an update mean crashes or power loss.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: SoC temperature per Pi. Sustained 80 C (red line) throttles the Pi; move it away from heat.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Free bytes on each Pi's data disk. A steady slope toward 500 MB (red line) needs a cleanup before the card fills.

panels.title: SD-card errors
panels.description: SD-card I/O errors since boot per Pi. Any step up means the card is failing; swap in the spare.

panels.title: Pi and hub warnings & errors
panels.description: Warning and error lines from the selected stores' Pis and hubs. Update, printer and link problems show here first.
